string.name: doc_visits_intro
string.value: Going to a doctor? Say why and what worries you. The app builds a safety brief for that doctor.

string.name: doc_visits_empty
string.value: No visits yet. Add one to prepare your questions.

string.name: doc_reason_hint
string.value: For example: check-up, wisdom tooth, new medicine

string.name: doc_worries_hint
string.value: Anything you want to ask or are unsure about

string.name: doc_privacy_caption
string.value: Your answers are saved on this phone. Names, phone numbers and e-mail addresses are removed before anything is sent for the AI summary.

string.name: doc_delete_msg
string.value: The visit and its summary are removed from this phone.

string.name: doc_my_visits_sub
string.value: Save a visit with your reason and worries

string.name: doc_summary_saved
string.value: Saved with this visit. Generated text, checked for doses and reassurance; the brief below is from your own records.

string.name: doc_feel_intro
string.value: A quick note for your diary. It stays on this phone.

string.name: doc_feel_low
string.value: Not feeling well? Logging the symptom helps your doctor see it.

string.name: doc_widget_desc
string.value: Add a diary entry in one tap
